mechanism_log: The system has a structured causal model with key features: (1) Y3 depends ONLY on X1 and X4, with a nonlinear saturating relationship and moderate X1*X4 interaction (std=0.10). Both must be moderate-to-high for Y3≥0.4. (2) Y4 depends on X3 (strongest), X6, X2, and slightly X1, but NOT on X4. X5 decreases Y4. (3) Y1 is driven by all 6 inputs (all positive), with X6 and X3 being strongest. X1's effect on Y1 is highly nonlinear (gradient drops 12x from low to high X1). (4) Y2 is decreased by X4, X2, X1 (helpful for minimization) and increased by X5, X3, X6 (harmful). The main trade-off is Y1 vs Y2: inputs that increase Y1 tend to also increase Y2, except X1, X2, X4 which are universally beneficial (increase Y1, decrease Y2, help Y3 and/or Y4).

The system has a highly structured causal model with strong nonlinearities and regime-dependent behavior. KEY STRUCTURE: (1) Y3 depends ONLY on X1 and X4, with a moderate X1*X4 interaction. Setting X1=1, X4=1 guarantees Y3≈0.997 (well above 0.4 threshold). (2) Y4 depends on X3 (strongest, gradient 0.20-0.28), X6, X2, X1 (weak), and X5 (negative). X4 has exactly zero effect on Y4. (3) Y1 is driven by all 6 inputs with massive nonlinearity: at high X3/X6 values, gradients amplify dramatically (X3 gradient goes from 0.38 at center to 1.28 at extremes). X5's effect REVERSES at extreme settings (positive at center, negative at extremes). (4) Y2 is decreased by X1, X2, X4 and increased by X3, X6 at moderate levels, but X5's Y2 effect also reverses at extremes. OPTIMIZATION INSIGHT: The efficient frontier uses X1=1, X2=1, X4=1 (universally beneficial), X5=0.1 (avoids Y2/Y4 damage), then varies X3 (primary trade-off lever between Y1/Y4 vs Y2) and X6 (secondary lever). The Pareto front is well-mapped with hypervolume nearly doubled from 0.148 to ~0.27.
